question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Valiant
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Valiant' **describes someone who shows courage or determination.

 
 
• **Example: **The valiant soldiers fought bravely in the war.
 
 
 
• **'Cowardly' **refers to someone lacking courage, making it an antonym of 'valiant'.
 
 
• **Example:** The cowardly thief ran away when he saw the security guard.
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer **is- Option 1:** 'Cowardly'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Similar'** (Option 2) refers to the likeness or resemblance of two or more entities.
 
• **'Heroic'** (Option 3) refers to behaving or doing something as a hero would, which aligns with 'valiant'.
 
• **'Dull' **(Option 4) refers to lacking interest or excitement, which doesn't really pertain to the context of 'valiant'.
